title: Can You Paddleboard on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes, on the Day Trip: paddle boards come out at the swim stop at Fajã dos Padres, under the cliffs, when the sea allows. Beginners can start on their knees.
heroAlt: A paddle boarder kneeling on a board in deep blue water under the cliffs of Fajã dos Padres
keywords: can you paddleboard on a boat trip in madeira
sup on a boat trip funchal
is paddle boarding hard for beginners

images.prompt: Seen from water level and from the side, a person seen from behind kneeling on a paddle board in deep blue water, paddle in hand, moving along the shore under the tall brown cliff of Fajã dos Padres in Madeira. A pebble beach and the green of the small farm at the foot of the cliff, the thin cable car line on the rock face. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy holds position further out. Late morning light, true colours.
images.alt: A paddle boarder kneeling on a board in deep blue water under the cliffs of Fajã dos Padres
